decision.summary: A gas smell was reported by Jonah Okafor (T-1002, vulnerable). The AI line failed ID because it checked the wrong record (T-1001, Amelia Clarke) and never ran find_tenant; his DOB matches T-1002. I opened emergency job JOB-101 and told the tenant, the landlord and Bow Gas (Gas Safe). E-4901 is invalid; E-4902 is valid and stays open.

answers.question: What is the situation and most urgent thing?
answers.answer: Possible gas leak at 27 Bethnal Green Road with a vulnerable tenant. Most urgent: make sure he is outside and has called NGES 0800 111 999, then get a Gas Safe engineer. Safety advice was given on the call; I re-sent it and asked him to confirm he is safe.

answers.question: Are E-4901 and E-4902 both valid?
answers.answer: No. E-4901 is invalid: the check ran against the wrong record (T-1001), the caller is T-1002 and his DOB matches. E-4902 is valid P1 and stays open until the gas job is progressed.

answers.question: Actions in next hour and who is told?
answers.answer: Created JOB-101; messaged tenant by SMS and email; emailed landlord (same-day, emergency pre-approved); messaged Bow Gas to confirm attendance after NGES; noted E-4901 invalid; scheduled a same-day follow-up.

conflicts: AI line verified against T-1001 (Amelia Clarke, DOB 1991-03-14) but the caller is T-1002 Jonah Okafor, DOB 1985-11-02 in CRM; trusted the CRM tenant record.
